name: Mario Mattera
site_label: Home, More About Mario and Issues pages
bottom_line: The labor and board biography checks out, but the site is largely unrevised since 2020, and its count of union years conflicts with earlier reporting.
findings: The site still describes him as seeking "to replace Senator John Flanagan" and gives the 2024 election date, while the header says "Re-elect."
"Member and leader of Local 200 for over 39 years" conflicts with 2020 reporting (TBR and the Suffolk GOP announcement) that he had been a member for about 25 years; his Senate bio now says over 43.
The $250 million in benefit funds and his Suffolk County Water Authority board service are confirmed by SCWA releases.
page_issues: Mixed 2020, 2024 and 2026 text: "replace Senator John Flanagan," "Tuesday, November 5th," and "Mattera 2026."
No votes, bills or legislative record are cited anywhere on the site.
